description: This file implements the HttpEncoder class functions for serializing various HTTP/QUIC frames, including data, headers, settings, goaway, priority update, accept-ch, greasing, web transport stream, and metadata frames within the quic namespace.

methods.name: GetDataFrameHeaderLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of the data frame header based on payload length.

methods.name: SerializeDataFrameHeader
methods.description: Serializes the data frame header into a buffer.

methods.name: SerializeHeadersFrameHeader
methods.description: Serializes the headers frame header into a string.

methods.name: SerializeSettingsFrame
methods.description: Serializes a settings frame with provided settings.

methods.name: SerializeGoAwayFrame
methods.description: Serializes a goaway frame with given goaway information.

methods.name: SerializeAcceptChFrame
methods.description: Serializes an accept-CH frame with entries.

methods.name: SerializeGreasingFrame
methods.description: Serializes a greasing frame with optional randomness.

methods.name: SerializeWebTransportStreamFrameHeader
methods.description: Serializes a WebTransport stream frame header with session ID.
